Trineteshwar temple (Devanagari: त्रिनेतेश्वर महादेव मंदिर) is a Shiva temple of Gurjar Pratihar style, located in the Tarnetar village of Surendranagar district, Gujarat. It was built by Mihir Bhoj of Gurjara pratihara dynasty, in the eighth century.
The temple is known for its annual fair, Trinetreshwar Mahadev Mela.
